cover: Escalating regional clashes, natural disasters, and sharp geopolitical maneuvers dominate global developments
cover_scene: A split vista showing military checkpoints in arid hills alongside emergency rescue crews searching collapsed rubble at dawn

slides.scene: Heavily armed soldiers manning a fortified concrete checkpoint in the dusty hills of the West Bank at sundown
slides.headline: Israel Orders Lockdown Across West Bank
slides.body: Israeli authorities imposed a sweeping closure across the occupied West Bank after an attack killed two Israeli soldiers. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pledged an expanded military operation as troops sealed checkpoints and began demolishing structures in Hebron.

slides.scene: A diplomatic briefing room with Ukrainian and American flags silhouetted against a map marking front lines
slides.headline: US Brokers Localized Truce in Ukraine
slides.body: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a localized ceasefire in the besieged southern city of Oleshky following diplomatic talks brokered by the United States. The White House credited Melania Trump with negotiating the pact for the humanitarian relief of trapped residents.

slides.scene: Emergency responders in bright orange gear digging through shattered masonry under floodlights in mountainous Tibet
slides.headline: Powerful Earthquake Hits China's Tibet Region
slides.body: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck remote Tibet, killing at least 16 people and injuring dozens more. Emergency responders deployed through high-altitude terrain to assess structural devastation and rescue survivors trapped under collapsed buildings in remote mountain settlements.

slides.scene: Voting booths adorned with red, white, and blue curtains inside a dimly lit civic gymnasium
slides.headline: Supreme Court Blocks Student IDs for Voting
slides.body: The Supreme Court granted an emergency order barring the use of college student identification cards for voting in New Hampshire. The ruling reverses lower court decisions, restricting polling place identification rules ahead of the looming November midterm elections.

slides.scene: Medical staff working by flashlight in a darkened, damaged operating theatre inside a warzone hospital
slides.headline: RSF Paramilitaries Systematically Target Sudanese Hospitals
slides.body: A BBC investigation revealed that Sudan's Rapid Support Forces have systematically seized, looted, and attacked hospitals across the country. Paramilitaries turned critical healthcare centers into fortified military bases, leaving hundreds of thousands of civilians without access to life-saving medical care.
